import unreal
# find any niagara module script that references render target write
ar=unreal.AssetRegistryHelpers.get_asset_registry()
assets=ar.get_assets_by_path('/Niagara/Modules',recursive=True)
hits=[]
for a in assets:
    n=str(a.asset_name)
    if any(k in n.lower() for k in ['rendertarget','writetexture','settexture','exportto','grid2d','rasterize','depositto','scatter']):
        hits.append(str(a.package_name))
print('COUNT',len(hits))
print('\n'.join(sorted(set(hits))))
